description: This file defines the PurchaseInvoice class and related functions for handling purchase invoice operations in ERPNext, including validation, GL entry creation, status updates, and document linking.

classes.name: WarehouseMissingError
classes.description: Custom exception for missing warehouse in purchase invoice items.

classes.name: PurchaseInvoice
classes.description: Main class representing a purchase invoice, including methods for validation, submission, cancellation, and GL entry creation.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the PurchaseInvoice object.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Method called when the document is loaded; sets onload properties.

methods.name: before_save
methods.description: Pre-save hook to reset release_date if not on hold.

methods.name: invoice_is_blocked
methods.description: Checks if the invoice is blocked based on hold status and release date.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks before saving or submitting.

methods.name: validate_release_date
methods.description: Ensures release date is in the future.

methods.name: validate_cash
methods.description: Validates cash/bank account and paid amount constraints.

methods.name: create_remarks
methods.description: Creates remarks based on bill number and date if not provided.

methods.name: set_missing_values
methods.description: Sets default values for missing fields like credit_to and due_date.

methods.name: check_conversion_rate
methods.description: Validates the currency conversion rate.

methods.name: validate_credit_to_acc
methods.description: Validates the credit account is a balance sheet and payable account.

methods.name: check_on_hold_or_closed_status
methods.description: Checks if linked purchase orders are on hold or closed.

methods.name: validate_with_previous_doc
methods.description: Validates references to previous documents like Purchase Order and Purchase Receipt.

methods.name: validate_warehouse
methods.description: Validates warehouse presence for stock items.

methods.name: validate_item_code
methods.description: Ensures item code is provided for each item.

methods.name: set_expense_account
methods.description: Determines expense accounts for items based on stock, asset, and other conditions.

methods.name: set_against_expense_account
methods.description: Sets the against expense account field based on item expense accounts.

methods.name: po_required
methods.description: Checks if purchase order is required for items.

methods.name: pr_required
methods.description: Checks if purchase receipt is required for stock items.

methods.name: validate_write_off_account
methods.description: Ensures write-off account is provided if write-off amount exists.

methods.name: check_prev_docstatus
methods.description: Verifies linked purchase orders and receipts are submitted.

methods.name: update_status_updater_args
methods.description: Prepares arguments for updating linked document statuses.

methods.name: validate_purchase_receipt_if_update_stock
methods.description: Prevents stock update if purchase receipt is linked.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles operations upon submission, including stock ledger update and GL entries.

methods.name: make_gl_entries
methods.description: Generates GL entries for the purchase invoice.

methods.name: get_gl_entries
methods.description: Constructs list of GL entries based on invoice data.

methods.name: check_asset_cwip_enabled
methods.description: Checks if any fixed asset uses CWIP accounting.

methods.name: make_supplier_gl_entry
methods.description: Creates GL entry for supplier account.

methods.name: make_item_gl_entries
methods.description: Creates GL entries for items, stock, landed costs, and assets.

methods.name: make_stock_adjustment_entry
methods.description: Creates stock adjustment GL entries if stock ledger values mismatch.

methods.name: make_tax_gl_entries
methods.description: Creates GL entries for taxes and valuation adjustments.

methods.name: enable_discount_accounting
methods.description: Property to check if discount accounting is enabled.

methods.name: make_internal_transfer_gl_entries
methods.description: Creates GL entries for internal transfers.

methods.name: make_payment_gl_entries
methods.description: Creates GL entries for payments made.

methods.name: make_write_off_gl_entry
methods.description: Creates GL entries for write-offs.

methods.name: make_gle_for_rounding_adjustment
methods.description: Creates GL entries for rounding adjustments.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles operations upon cancellation, including reversing GL entries and updating statuses.

methods.name: update_project
methods.description: Updates project costing based on invoice items.

methods.name: validate_supplier_invoice
methods.description: Validates invoice date and bill number for uniqueness.

methods.name: update_billing_status_in_pr
methods.description: Updates billing status in purchase receipt items.

methods.name: on_recurring
methods.description: Handles recurring invoice setup.

methods.name: block_invoice
methods.description: Blocks the invoice from further processing.

methods.name: unblock_invoice
methods.description: Unblocks the invoice.

methods.name: set_tax_withholding
methods.description: Sets TDS and tax withholding details.

methods.name: allocate_advance_tds
methods.description: Allocates TDS on advances.

methods.name: update_advance_tax_references
methods.description: Updates references for advance taxes.

methods.name: set_status
methods.description: Sets the status of the invoice based on outstanding and other conditions.
